protocol.fit_schedule: First requested monthly signal in each calendar quarter; frozen within quarter
protocol.training_window: Expanding complete-feature stock observations; at least 12 distinct label months
protocol.purge: Training label_date strictly precedes the quarterly fit signal_date
protocol.label: Next calendar-month adjusted close / signal adjusted close - 1; clipped to [-.50,.50] only in fitting
protocol.ranking: Forecast magnitude, linear expected-profit whole-lot allocation; dated DC price association remains an eligibility gate only
protocol.daily_features: Complete 25-session gap-invariant intraday pressure and amount windows, not close-to-close total return
protocol.context: Past 60-session gap-neutral intraday-pressure cohorts; fixed MiniBatchKMeans20, seed42, three initializations, maxiter60, batch1024; >=10 complete-history stocks; cohort adjusted-momentum medians and positive3 breadth; not industry membership
